subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a multi-turn model lease for `/model --turns N`, and should it share one contract with the one-turn model override work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100876?
rationale: The request changes public command/API behavior, config shape, session persistence, provider/model authorization, and user-facing revert semantics; the correct contract is a product/API choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
options.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share validation, state, response reporting, warning, revert, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

options.title: Limit scope to one-turn overrides
options.body: Keep or close this issue only if maintainers intentionally support atomic one-turn overrides but reject N-turn leases and configured turn limits.

options.title: Preserve sticky model selection only
options.body: Reject temporary model leases and direct users to current `/model default` plus persistent session model selection behavior.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract first
recommendation.body: Create or update the canonical design so one-turn and N-turn model overrides share validation, state, response reporting, warning, revert, docs, and upgrade semantics before code is queued.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points most strongly to this owner around model override, live-switch, and session patch contract boundaries.
